title: Final report figure campaign
time_policy: Full recorded traces from first logged sample at t=0. Calibration is included whenever logged. Additional zooms never replace full plots. Missing startup/calibration records must be declared, not fabricated.
raw_policy: Raw records are immutable. Reuse a source acquisition by a recorded path and hash; never re-run hardware merely to fill a comparison folder.
metrics_policy: Separate recovery, steady and full-record windows; record units and definitions. Use common support for paired error metrics, but retain both full traces in figures. Never claim independent real position truth or measured motor torque from model/odometry alone.
hardware_policy: Preparation creates directories only; hardware starts only for an explicitly prepared and authorized physical configuration.
